      done=art(ctx,'storm_cloud',0,bx+18,by-16,70,28,0,fade*.56)||done;
   }
   const lift=cl(t/.68);
   done=art(ctx,'tornado',0,bx-18,by+12-Math.sin(t*Math.PI)*4,30,58,0,fade*.88)||done;
   done=art(ctx,'tornado',0,bx+18,by+10-Math.sin(t*Math.PI)*3,24,48,0,fade*.75)||done;
   for(let i=0;i<(slow?3:5);i++){
      const q=cl(t/.84-i*.09); if(q<=.01) continue;
      const x=mix(ax,bx,q), y=mix(ay,by,q)-10+Math.sin(q*8+i)*10;
      done=art(ctx,'wind_loop',0,x,y,18+q*14,20+q*18,elapsed*.005+i*.5,fade*(.25+.45*q))||done;
      if(i%2===0) done=art(ctx,'spark',0,x+5,y,16+q*10,16+q*10,0,fade*(.25+.28*q))||done;
   }
   if(t>.2&&t<.82&&e)e.shake=Math.max(e.shake||0,3.8);
 }
 if(done)counts[key]++; return done;
}
const original=window.PokemonTorreV360Paint;
window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,e){

// V35.76 · refino visual: Psybeam / Tempestade de Neve / Fúria Ancestral / Céu Tempestuoso.
(function(){
'use strict';
const SPRITES={"rock":"data:image/png;base64,","hail":"data:image/png;base64,","snowflake":"data:image/png;base64,","ring":"data:image/png;base64,","orb":"data:image/png;base64,","tornado":"data:image/png;base64,"};
const TARGETS=new Set(['psybeam','tempestadedeneve','furiaancestral','ceutempestuoso']);
const images={};
for(const k in SPRITES){ const im=new Image(); im.src=SPRITES[k]; images[k]=im; }
const counts={psybeam:0,tempestadedeneve:0,furiaancestral:0,ceutempestuoso:0};
const norm=s=>String(s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
const clamp=v=>Math.max(0,Math.min(1,v));
const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
const prevPainter=window.PokemonTorreV360Paint;
function drawPath(ctx,pts,width,color,alphaMul){
  if(!pts || pts.length<2) return;
  ctx.save(); ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.lineJoin='round';
  ctx.strokeStyle=color.replace('ALPHA', String((alphaMul||1)*0.18)); ctx.lineWidth=width*2.4;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]); for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle=color.replace('ALPHA', String(alphaMul||1)); ctx.lineWidth=width;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]); for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}
function glow(ctx,x,y,r,inner,outer,a){
  const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);
  g.addColorStop(0, inner.replace('ALPHA', String(a)));
  g.addColorStop(1, outer.replace('ALPHA','0'));
  ctx.save(); ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
}
function sprite(ctx,key,x,y,w,h,opt){
  opt=opt||{}; const img=images[key]; if(!img||!img.complete||img.naturalWidth<1) return false;
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.rotate(opt.rot||0); ctx.globalAlpha=opt.alpha==null?1:opt.alpha; ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  ctx.drawImage(img,-w/2,-h/2,w,h); ctx.restore(); return true;
}
function impactRing(ctx,x,y,r,color,a){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle=color.replace('ALPHA', String(a)); ctx.lineWidth=2.2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x,y,r,r*0.72,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle=color.replace('ALPHA', String(a*0.25)); ctx.lineWidth=6;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x,y,r,r*0.72,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}
function sparkLine(ctx,x1,y1,x2,y2,segments,amp,color,a){
  const dx=x2-x1, dy=y2-y1, len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1, nx=-dy/len, ny=dx/len;
  const pts=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=segments;i++){
    const t=i/segments;
    const wave=(i===0||i===segments)?0:((i%2===0?1:-1)*amp*(0.6+0.12*(i%3)));
    pts.push([lerp(x1,x2,t)+nx*wave, lerp(y1,y2,t)+ny*wave]);
  }
  drawPath(ctx,pts,2,color,a);
}

function drawPsybeam(ctx,fx,now,state){
  const elapsed=Math.max(0,now-fx.at), dur=Math.max(880,fx.duration||880), t=clamp(elapsed/dur);
  const from=fx.from||[0,0], to=fx.to||[0,0];
  const ax=from[0], ay=from[1], bx=to[0], by=to[1];
  const dx=bx-ax, dy=by-ay, len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1, nx=-dy/len, ny=dx/len;
  const prog=clamp(t/0.82);
  const pts=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=20;i++){
    const q=(i/20)*prog;
    const wave=Math.sin(q*15-elapsed*0.016)*10 + Math.sin(q*7+elapsed*0.011)*4;
    const x=lerp(ax,bx,q)+nx*wave, y=lerp(ay,by,q)+ny*wave;
    pts.push([x,y]);
    glow(ctx,x,y,9+7*q,'rgba(255,225,255,ALPHA)','rgba(162,55,255,ALPHA)',0.2+0.5*q);
    if(i%4===0) sprite(ctx,'ring',x,y,16+8*q,12+6*q,{rot:q*10+elapsed*0.002,alpha:0.72});
    if(i%5===2) sprite(ctx,'orb',x+Math.cos(i+elapsed*0.01)*2,y+Math.sin(i+elapsed*0.01)*2,11+6*q,11+6*q,{alpha:0.9});
  }
  drawPath(ctx,pts,4,'rgba(255,170,255,ALPHA)',0.92);
  drawPath(ctx,pts,2,'rgba(170,80,255,ALPHA)',0.96);
  if(t>0.46){
    const p=clamp((t-0.46)/0.32);
    glow(ctx,bx,by,26+26*p,'rgba(255,255,255,ALPHA)','rgba(200,90,255,ALPHA)',0.8*(1-p*0.1));
    impactRing(ctx,bx,by,10+24*p,'rgba(238,190,255,ALPHA)',0.86*(1-p*0.12));
    sprite(ctx,'ring',bx,by,22+24*p,18+18*p,{rot:elapsed*0.006,alpha:0.75*(1-p*0.1)});
  }
  if(state && t>0.12 && t<0.8) state.shake=Math.max(state.shake||0,2.1);
  counts.psybeam++; return true;
}

function drawBlizzard(ctx,fx,now,state){
  const elapsed=Math.max(0,now-fx.at), dur=Math.max(960,fx.duration||960), t=clamp(elapsed/dur);
  const to=fx.to||[0,0], bx=to[0], by=to[1];
  glow(ctx,bx,by,34,'rgba(235,245,255,ALPHA)','rgba(110,185,255,ALPHA)',0.26+0.1*Math.sin(elapsed*0.012));
  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
    const ang=i*2.399 + elapsed*0.012 + t*5.5;
    const radius=8 + ((i*11+elapsed*0.06)%34);
    const x=bx+Math.cos(ang)*radius, y=by+Math.sin(ang)*radius*0.65;
    if(i%3===0) sprite(ctx,'snowflake',x,y,14,14,{rot:ang,alpha:0.78});
    else sprite(ctx,'hail',x,y,14,14,{alpha:0.66});
  }
  for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
    const fall=((elapsed*0.32 + i*13) % 110) - 55;
    const drift=Math.sin(i*2 + elapsed*0.008)*8;
    const x=bx-36+(i%6)*14+drift, y=by-55+fall;
    ctx.save(); ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(230,245,255,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth=1.4;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y); ctx.lineTo(x-2.5,y+8); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore();
  }
  if(t>0.52){
    const p=clamp((t-0.52)/0.28);

function drawAncientPower(ctx,fx,now,state){
  const elapsed=Math.max(0,now-fx.at), dur=Math.max(980,fx.duration||980), t=clamp(elapsed/dur);
  const from=fx.from||[0,0], to=fx.to||[0,0];

  if(state && t>0.28 && t<0.9) state.shake=Math.max(state.shake||0,3.2);

function drawStormSky(ctx,fx,now,state){

window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,state){
  const key=norm(fx&&((fx.move&&fx.move.name)||fx.name));
  if(!TARGETS.has(key)) return prevPainter?prevPainter(ctx,fx,now,state):false;

  if(key==='tempestadedeneve') return drawBlizzard(ctx,fx,now,state);
